description: Search the public Monity Network: trackers people publish on pages they track (prices, stock, releases, pricing pages, status pages, policies), and the people who run them. Give words ("ps5 restock", "openai pricing") or a page address. Returns trackers and people with their slugs for the other Network tools. In the results, `watches` are trackers with one source, `watchlists` are trackers with several, and `hunters` are people.

type.description: Only one kind (default all): watches and watchlists are trackers, hunters are people

name: search_network
title: Search Monity Network
